en: The image shows the back of a vintage postcard covered in handwritten Cyrillic script, mainly in blue ink. There are two green postage stamps featuring a profile portrait of a man, with the word 'България' (Bulgaria) at the top. There are also multiple postal markings and stamps. The handwriting appears dense and covers most of the card, with some names and addresses written in larger letters.
